articles.title: Saudi Arabia says it struck Iran-backed groups in Iraq with US coordination
articles.summary: Saudi Arabia, in coordination with U.S. CENTCOM, conducted targeted strikes against Iran-backed groups in Iraq. These groups were identified as responsible for recent destabilizing activities. This joint operation underscores ongoing regional security challenges and the cooperative efforts between Saudi Arabia and the U.S. to counter threats from state and non-state actors in the Middle East.

articles.title: US, Saudi forces strike Iran-backed 'terrorists' in Iraq: US military
articles.summary: US and Saudi warplanes conducted joint strikes in Iraq on July 28 against Iran-backed militants. This action was a direct response to over two dozen recent drone attacks launched by these groups. The operation underscores the persistent efforts by international forces to counter regional instability and address threats posed by proxy militias in the Middle East, a crucial development for understanding global security dynamics.

articles.title: Parul, Sreeshankar lead India's Day 7 medal charge at CWG
articles.summary: India's athletics stars Parul Chaudhary and Murali Sreeshankar will spearhead the nation's campaign on Day 7 of the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow. Their participation underscores India's growing presence in international sports, with both athletes aiming to secure medals. This highlights India's global sporting aspirations and the dedication of its athletes to bring laurels to the country.

articles.title: Army initiates specialised 14-day training for CISF personnel to tackle security challenges
articles.summary: The Indian Army is providing specialized training to CISF personnel at Agartala Military Station. This joint program emphasizes advanced security protocols and tactical preparedness. The initiative's primary goal is to significantly bolster aviation security and enhance capabilities to counter emerging threats across Indian airports, showcasing crucial inter-agency cooperation vital for national defence and security preparedness for future officers.

articles.title: Ahmedabad tragedy: Supreme Court accepts pilot dad's plea not to make Air India crash report public
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has accepted a plea from the father of a pilot involved in an Air India crash, linked to the "Ahmedabad tragedy," to keep the accident report private. This decision prevents the public disclosure of the investigation details, prioritizing the family's privacy. The ruling pertains to a historical Air India accident, emphasizing the legal protection of sensitive information concerning past aviation incidents.

articles.title: Two schoolchildren die in Surat, Dhrangadhra
articles.summary: Tragedy struck as two schoolchildren reportedly died in separate incidents across India, with one fatality in Surat and another in Dhrangadhra. This brief report confirms the deaths but provides no further details regarding the causes, specific circumstances, or the ages of the children involved. Further information would be essential for a complete understanding of these unfortunate events.
